title: The kernel mean embedding of a random probability distribution and its principal components
abstract: arXiv:2610.33286v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given a random probability distribution \(F\), whose realizations are defined on \(\mathbb R^d\), and a kernel \(k\), our aim is to analyze the properties of the kernel mean embedding, \(\mu_F\), of \(F\) as a random element of the corresponding reproducing kernel Hilbert space \(\mathcal H\). This establishes a rigorous framework in which kernel statistical techniques for distributional data can be stated both in the sample and population settings and, thus, the asymptotic properties of sample procedures can be properly established. As an illustration of this approach we focus on the principal components of \(F\). We obtain a general convergence result and the explicit expression of the spectral decomposition for the uncentered covariance operator of a normal probability distribution with a Gaussian distributed expectation. translated_title: 随机概率分布的核均值嵌入及其主成分
translated_abstract: 给定一个随机概率分布 \(F\)，其实现定义在 \(\mathbb R^d\) 上，以及一个核函数 \(k\)，我们的目标是分析 \(F\) 的核均值嵌入 \(\mu_F\) 作为相应再生核希尔伯特空间 \(\mathcal H\) 中随机元素的各项性质。这建立了一个严格的框架，使得针对分布数据的核统计技术可以在样本和总体两种设定下加以表述，从而能够正确地建立样本方法的渐近性质。作为该方法的一个示例，我们重点研究 \(F\) 的主成分。我们获得了一般性的收敛结果，以及期望服从高斯分布的正态概率分布的非中心化协方差算子谱分解的显式表达式。该核主成分方法的性能通过仿真实验和数据分析得到了验证。
tldr: 本文将随机概率分布的核均值嵌入作为再生核希尔伯特空间中的随机元素建立了严格的理论框架，并推导出核主成分分析的一般收敛性结果以及正态分布情形下协方差算子谱分解的显式表达式。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a rigorous framework for the kernel mean embedding of a random probability distribution as a random element in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, deriving general convergence results and explicit spectral decompositions for kernel principal component analysis.
